# parts of a listed package on few legs, so each row added raises the modelled maximum (measured over the subsets of the 7 candidate
# packages at 13 legs: testshard + checkgo + splitshards + integrationshards 567 s, all four of leg 6 listed 622 s). racescope (166 s in two
# parts), checkgoshards (177 s) and outboundtransport (146 s) are not listed: their parts can share a leg with a listed package.
